analysis.rationale: Single-step glass blur. run_full_analysis: block_boundary=1.003 (no JPEG), unique_G=235 (no quantization), glass_score=0.468>0.25 with gm_ratio=0.504; PCA=1.078<2.5 and FFT=2.174<2.2 exclude motion. Pair0 test_candidate: glass:2 PSNR=30.25dB CI=10/10 with all CI metric diffs ~0.000 (overshoot/zero-crossing/hf-lf exact match, the pixel-shuffle glass fingerprint); severity scan brackets optimum (glass:1=28.93, glass:2=30.25, glass:3=27.27). Cross-family tests gaussian:2=29.19 (CI 8/10), lens:2=28.90 (CI 9/10), motion:3=21.75 all worse. JPEG control (glass:2+jpeg:1) drops PSNR to 29.46 and CI to 7/10 (block_boundary err 66%) -> NO_COMPRESSION. Noise control (glass:2+noise_gaussian_RGB:1) collapses PSNR to 24.63 and CI to 3/10 -> NO_NOISE. All 4 support pairs re-tested with blur_glass:2: PSNR 39.76/35.63/33.19/32.20 dB, CI 10/10 each (all metric diffs <=0.001). Glass uses a random pixel shuffle (non-deterministic realization) so PSNR cannot exceed ~40dB even when correct (SKILL C.4); per SKILL D.4 the 5/5 identical statistical fingerprint (CI 10/10) constitutes sufficient indicator evidence, hence LIKELY.
